description.value:
Frequency once per day

Trigger You roll a check or a saving throw.

Roll twice and use the better result. This is a fortune effect. Treat the die result you keep as a natural 20 for the purpose of the natural-20 rule, even if the number itself is lower — the Croupier doesn't rig the number, only what it means. If the total still isn't enough to succeed, no natural 20 was ever promised, only better odds.

cinderfall.incomplete: "Roll twice, keep the better, and treat the kept die as a natural 20 for the nat-20 rule even if the number is lower" redefines the rolled-die value itself, distinct from a reroll (only one literal final die is used) and distinct from AdjustDegreeOfSuccess (it doesn't shift a success tier, it redefines the natural number, which matters separately for the natural-1/natural-20 auto-crit rule). No rule element retroactively redefines a rolled value -- confirmed absent via exhaustive grep across pf2e-source for this shape throughout this pass.
